articles.summary: Third quarter net income of $1.34 per diluted share and adjusted operating income of $1.34 per diluted share Third quarter 2026 highlights compared to third quarter 2025, unless otherwise noted: (1) Net income decreased $4.1 million to $35.1 million. Net investment income increased 13% to $29.3 million. Combined ratio increased 2.7 points to 94.6%, composed of an underlying loss ratio of 57.3%, catastrophe loss ratio of 2.4%, no prior year reserve development, and underwriting expense ratio of 34.9%. Underlying combined ratio increased 1.6 points to 92.2%. Net written premium (2) increased 13% to $371.4 million. Book value per share decreased $0.37 to $36.51 as of September 30, 2026, compared to December 31, 2025. Adjusted book value per share increased $3.07 to $40.94 as of September 30, 2026, compared to December 31, 2025. Return on equity was 14.0% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. CEDAR RAPIDS, Iowa, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - United Fire Group, Inc. (UFG)

articles.summary: CEDAR RAPIDS, Iowa, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Today, the board of directors of United Fire Group, Inc. (UFG) (Nasdaq: UFCS) declared a common stock quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share. This dividend will be payable December 18, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 4, 2026. UFG has a long history of paying quarterly dividends dating back to March 1968. About UFG Founded in 1946 as United Fire Casualty Company, UFG, through its insurance company subsidiaries, is engaged in the business of writing property and casualty insurance. The company is licensed as a property and casualty insurer in 50 states and the District of Columbia, and is represented by approximately 850 independent agencies. AM Best assigns a rating of “A-” (Excellent) for members of the United Fire Casualty Group. For more information about UFG, visit www.ufginsurance.com.
